The maintainer does not attempt to fetch or execute any additional scripts during source retrieval or PKGBUILD sourcing. While the package installs German language support and modifies system directories in `package()`, those actions are deferred and irrelevant under `--nobuild --noprepare`. Thus, running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` poses no risk of unintended code execution or data leakage.
</details>
